headline: Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen
notes: Level Headlines daily brief 18 Nov, citing Reuters and The Hindu: Xi and Putin began talks in Shenzhen on Wednesday, a day before a first trilateral summit with Trump. JustSecurity 18 Nov confirms Xi greeted Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen.

headline: Iran hits Kuwait and Bahrain
notes: Reuters 18 Nov: Iran says it fired on US drone and missile sites in Kuwait overnight after the US struck Qeshm Island; first Iranian attack on Kuwait since September. Bahrain intercepted Iranian attacks for a third time in a week.

headline: Crimea bridge span falls to the sea
notes: Horizon 18 Nov geopolitics: the Crimea bridge partially collapses under Ukrainian attack. DATE CHECK: the strike was 17 Nov; the collapse was confirmed in 18 Nov reporting. Petersworld 18 Nov update also reports the span fell.

headline: Russian strikes kill five in Odesa
notes: Conflict briefing for 18 Nov: Russian airstrikes killed at least four people and injured 13 in Odesa on 18 Nov; at least five fatalities nationwide that day. Kyiv bridges also hit, per Petersworld 18 Nov.

headline: Israeli tanks cross Gaza line
notes: BBC News 18 Nov 20:29 UTC: Israeli tanks advance across the Gaza ceasefire line in a rare incursion; BBC 20:14 UTC reports a rare ground operation beyond the Yellow Line. Three civilians killed, per 18 Nov reports.

headline: Peltola wins Alaska Senate race
notes: AP via Level Headlines 18 Nov: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated two-term Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska, the last Senate race of the midterms; Democrats gain a 56-44 Senate majority after flipping nine GOP-held seats. JustSecurity 18 Nov confirms.

headline: US loses measles status
notes: PAHO regional commission via Level Headlines 18 Nov and CDC: the US no longer meets measles elimination criteria after a single transmission chain ran more than 12 months. Horizon 18 Nov: more than 5,400 cases and 10 deaths.

headline: Nvidia sales hit $115.8bn
notes: CNBC via Level Headlines 18 Nov: Nvidia Q3 revenue $115.8bn, up 103% year over year, adjusted EPS $2.68, above LSEG estimates of $109.1bn and $2.48; Q4 guided near $130bn. Reuters Trading Day 18 Nov: shares fell about 3% on the day.

headline: Anthropic IPO priced at $83
notes: Reuters Trading Day 18 Nov: Anthropic priced its IPO on Wednesday at $83 a share, above its targeted $70-78 range, with the offering size increased; valuation set north of $1.4 trillion.

headline: EU plans 45bn euro Ukraine loan
notes: Reuters via Level Headlines 18 Nov: the European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro loan to Ukraine, to be repaid only after Russia pays war reparations. AppiSToS 18 Nov 15:22 UTC confirms the proposal: up to 25bn military and 20bn budget support.

headline: Imamoglu gets two more years
notes: Reuters 18 Nov 15:59 UTC: a Turkish court sentenced jailed Istanbul mayor Ekrem Imamoglu to a further two years in prison for violating election law and imposed a new political ban.

headline: UniCredit agrees Commerzbank deal
notes: Reuters 18 Nov: UniCredit and Germany reached agreement on the big sticking points in the takeover of Commerzbank; the merged bank German HQ stays in Frankfurt as a listed entity; combined assets over 1.3 trillion euro.

headline: Trump hails Manila trade deal
notes: Reuters via Level Headlines 18 Nov: Trump said Wednesday the US had concluded a very big trade deal with the Philippines but offered no details, while Philippine officials said the two countries had reached only an understanding on economic cooperation. CLAIM: the deal itself is Trump's word, Manila disagrees.

headline: Three leaders meet in China
notes: BBC via NewsBites 18 Nov 20:13 UTC: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands as leaders gather in China. JustSecurity 18 Nov: Xi greeted Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen; the three-way summit is Thursday.

headline: Uganda activist charged in court
notes: Reuters 18 Nov 16:33 UTC: former aide to jailed opposition figure Kizza Besigye, Sam Mugumya, appeared in military court in Kampala charged with treachery, more than a year after he was seized by armed men in August 2025.

headline: Bahrain stops Iran attacks again
notes: BBC and Reuters via Level Headlines 18 Nov: Bahrain said it intercepted Iranian aerial attacks for a third time in a week; Kuwait said it repelled the attack.

headline: Gaza baby dies of cold in floods
notes: Petersworld 18 Nov: WHO director-general said an eight-month-old in Gaza died of hypothermia after rain flooded camps, with 950,000 people in flood-prone areas. Horizon 18 Nov: cold threatens camps in Gaza.

headline: Mossad chief pushed Iran strikes
notes: Reuters 18 Nov: Mossad chief Roman Gofman lobbied US officials last week for new joint strikes on Iran, two people said.

headline: UK inflation rises to 3.6% in Oct
notes: Reuters Trading Day 18 Nov: UK inflation rose to 3.6% in October, the highest in a year.

headline: Fed minutes stay hawkish on prices
notes: Reuters Trading Day 18 Nov: Fed policymakers focused on inflation risks in October, with some seeing a need for a bigger rate hike; Governor Christopher Waller said Wednesday the Fed might need more aggressive action.

headline: Waymo halts driverless freeway rides
notes: TechCrunch and AP via Level Headlines 18 Nov: Waymo voluntarily suspended driverless taxi rides on freeways in all US markets after California DMV barred it from state freeways over construction-zone incursions.

headline: Mullin faces House hearing on outages
notes: AP via Level Headlines 18 Nov: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin is set to testify Wednesday before the House Homeland Security Committee amid questions about cyber infrastructure and the nationwide flight grounding.

headline: EU approves Indonesia trade signing
notes: AppiSToS 18 Nov 19:08 UTC, EU Council: the 18 November announcement concerns authorisation to sign the CEPA and IPA trade and investment agreements with Indonesia.

headline: Ethiopia, Eritrea mass border troops
notes: JustSecurity Early Edition 18 Nov, citing Reuters: Ethiopia and Eritrea have amassed forces along their shared border; sources said the build-up brought the two armies within striking distance.

headline: Romania quake M5.3 near Comandau
notes: USGS via NewsBites 18 Nov 20:52 UTC: M5.3, 16 km ESE of Comandau, Romania.

headline: Torrential rain floods South Florida
notes: BBC News 18 Nov 20:29 UTC: torrential rain causes widespread flooding in South Florida.

headline: Como win 9-1 at Lens, Douvikas treble
notes: A Sports 18 Nov 19:45 UTC: Como equalled the record for the biggest winning margin in the modern Champions League with a 9-1 win away to Lens; Anastasios Douvikas scored a hat-trick.

headline: Chelsea 1-0 PSG; Man City 2-0 Hacken
notes: PSG match report 18 Nov: PSG women lost 1-0 away to Chelsea on matchday 5 of the UEFA Womens Champions League, Buurman 87th minute. Sportradar 18 Nov: Manchester City beat Hacken Gothenburg 2-0.

headline: William and Kate meet Modi in India
notes: BBC News 18 Nov 20:07 UTC: William and Kate meet PM Modi as they wrap up their India tour.

headline: Cyclone Akvan nears India coast
notes: The Hindu via NewsBites 18 Nov: Cyclone Akvan likely to cross between Machilipatnam and Puri, per APSDMA live updates.

headline: Cambridge word of 2026 is human
notes: Anadolu Agency Today in 60 Seconds 18 Nov: Cambridge Dictionary named human its 2026 word of the year.

headline: Europe faces worst wildfire season
notes: Anadolu Agency 18 Nov: an EU report finds Europe faces its most intense wildfire season on record.

headline: Fiji declares drought disaster
notes: RNZ Pacific via Evening Report 18 Nov: Fiji declared a national state of natural disaster in response to an ongoing El Nino drought.

headline: Ebola in DR Congo hits children hardest
notes: Horizon 18 Nov: the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo is heavily affecting children; three out of four children under 5 die from it.
